load_table_transformer_model: load the microsoft table transformer model for structure recognition
run_batch_inference_on_images: run batch inference on PIL images to detect table rows and columns
transform_image_to_tensor: transform a PIL image into a normalized torch tensor for model input
convert_model_outputs_to_objects: convert model logits and bounding boxes into structured row and column objects
rescale_predicted_bounding_boxes: rescale normalized bounding boxes to original image dimensions
